reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: とにかく肌が荒れて低刺激なクレンジングで朝洗顔にも使えるということで購入。使用感としては、可もなく不可もなし。BBクリームが落ち切らないのか、小鼻は角栓が詰まった状態になってしまい、別途クレンジングバームを買って肌の状態に合わせて使っている。期待していた朝洗顔も特に良さを感じられずに別のものを使用中。肌が悪化することはなかったけど、使い切ったらリピートはしない。乾燥しないのは良かった。
reviews.zh: 總之皮膚成日敏感又爛，買咗呢支係因為佢標榜低刺激、可以當朝早洗面用。使用感覺上就一般，唔算好亦唔算差。BB cream 似乎冇徹底卸乾淨，搞到鼻翼位塞滿咗黑頭，要另外買咗支卸妝膏再按皮膚狀況使用。原本期待當朝早洗面用都感受唔到特別好處，所以已經轉咗用其他產品。冇令皮膚惡化算係好，但用完都唔會回購。唔會令皮膚乾燥呢一點係幾好。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: Love using this for morning cleansing but doesn’t do well when removing makeup. I do have to use more product to remove it more though . Will be sticking with oil cleanser when I wear makeup.
reviews.zh: 鍾意用佢嚟做朝早潔面，但卸妝就唔太得。要卸得乾淨啲就要用更多份量。化妝嘅時候我會繼續用卸妝油。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: Way better than using a cleansing oil. It felt moisturizing and I was scared it would irritate my sensitive skin since there is a slight pleasant scent but it didn't. I use this cleansing milk with the centella cleansing foam. Left my skin feeling refreshed and soft. Definitely will be repurchasing.
reviews.zh: 比起用卸妝油好好多。感覺好保濕，本來擔心因為佢帶少少好聞嘅香味會刺激到我敏感肌，但結果冇。我用呢支卸妝乳配搭 centella 潔面泡沫一齊用，洗完之後皮膚清爽又柔軟。一定會回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: Yeah, I get it now!! I was having tons of breakouts after starting my tretinoin treatment. I didn't understand the reason until I learned that cleansing oil were too tough on my sensitive, acne prone skin. I needed to find that balance to protect my skin. This is the holy grail! My face is not squeaky clean to the point where I break out any longer but now has a healthy glow with moisture after washing my face.
reviews.zh: 係呀，我終於明晒！自從開始用 tretinoin 治療之後我就成日爆瘡，點解會咁都搞唔清楚，直到後來知道原來係卸妝油對我敏感肌同暗瘡肌太猛。我需要搵到一個平衡去保護皮膚。呢支就係我嘅神器！而家洗面之後塊面唔再係嗰種繃到會爆瘡嘅乾淨，而係有健康嘅光澤同保濕感。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text:
Review: Extremely gentle and hydrating!
​The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Cleansing Milk is a lifesaver for sensitive skin. It has a beautiful, creamy texture that removes impurities without stripping away moisture. My face feels incredibly soft and calm after every wash. I love how the Centella and Hyaluronic Acid work together to soothe redness while keeping my skin hydrated. It’s the perfect first step for a gentle, effective skincare routine. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 評價：非常溫和又保濕！SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica 卸妝乳液係敏感肌嘅救星。佢有個好靚、奶滑嘅質地，可以清走污垢但唔會抽乾水分。每次洗完面塊面都感覺超柔軟又舒緩。我好鍾意 Centella 同透明質酸一齊發揮作用，邊舒緩泛紅邊幫皮膚保濕。係一個溫和又有效嘅護膚程序嘅完美第一步。高度推薦！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text:
one of my favorite cleansers i’ve used so far. 
my skin is quite dry and a shave my face daily and this cleanser helps with avoiding irritation and dryness.
reviews.zh: 至今用過最鍾意嘅潔面之一。我皮膚幾乾，而且每日都會剃面毛，呢款潔面幫我避免刺激同乾燥。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: An excellent-quality product! It has a very pleasant scent, an amazing texture, and provides great hydration. The product offers many benefits – it is very gentle, suitable for sensitive skin and for all ages. The packaging is convenient and well-designed. The size is great, and using it twice a week is more than enough, although I personally use it more frequently. It feels very comfortable on the skin and has become a permanent part of my routine. Overall, a fantastic product that I highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 質素超卓嘅產品！氣味好聞、質地一流，而且保濕效果好好。呢款產品有好多好處——非常溫和，適合敏感肌同所有年齡層。包裝方便又設計貼心。容量剛剛好，一星期用兩次已經好足夠，不過我自己會用得更密。上面感覺好舒服，已經成為我護膚程序嘅固定一部分。總括嚟講，係一款我高度推薦嘅出色產品！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk 200ml
reviews.text: I thought this was a fine cleansing milk. It does its job but its nothing special. I didn't like the scent, but that's personal preference
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款卸妝乳液普普通通。做到佢嘅本分，但冇咩特別。我唔鍾意個味，但呢個係個人口味。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
